alloy.preparation: Vacuum-induction melted from commercially pure feedstocks; nitrogen bled into furnace, Mn4N or CrN wrapped in iron foil added as needed. Cast solid ingot sections soaked 30 min and hot-rolled at 1205°C or 1095°C according to ductility; pickled in 10% HNO3 + 2% HF at 65°C, cold-rolled to 2 mm, annealed 1065°C for 5 min, water-quenched, and pickled again in the same solution. Strips 1.25 × 1.25 cm; type 308 rod welded for electrical contact and rubber-covered; epoxy-mounted, ground to 600 grit and rinsed in distilled water. Mount interface lacquered; about 1 cm² exposed; stored in desiccator.
alloy.microstructure: Austenitic stainless steel with some ferrite detected.

test_solution.preparation: Deoxygenated with purified nitrogen at 90 ml/min beginning 30 min before specimen immersion.

test_method.procedure_description: One-litre polarization cell with controlled temperature; specimen rinsed in distilled water before transfer. Scan begins 50 min after immersion at the corrosion potential; saturated calomel reference. PAR 173 potentiostat.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Ec: potential beyond which anodic current density rises very rapidly, indicating passive breakdown and actively growing pits. No-breakdown bounds retain their reported scan limit.

experiments.result_note: Ec is the authors’ rapid-current-rise criterion associated with actively growing pits. Table 1 uses an unspecified percentage basis; approximate/estimated entries remain approximate (footnote 1). Carbon <0.03% entries are upper limits, and carbon near 0.02% for heats 18–25 is approximate. A dash in the Mn column is left unreported, not zero.
